scope: Source evidence and blind metadata only. Existing early windows and both electrode systems retain their current contract.

development_existing.10.1021/acsomega.5c08826: OA047, TAK5; verify actual cycling protocol, independent positive markers, and author retention evidence
development_existing.10.1016/j.inoche.2021.108523: OPAC; locate public source for Fig. 7 protocol; preserve all gaps when not directly confirmed

blind_rule: For reserved papers, inspect only tagged role and protocol evidence. Do not print captions, results paragraphs, or view an unmasked cycle panel. At least three individually separable positive-cycle markers inside a window and identity/test binding are required for input planning. The normalization anchor does not count.

novel_metadata.query: (TITLE_ABS:supercapacitor OR TITLE_ABS:supercapacitors) AND (TITLE_ABS:biomass OR TITLE_ABS:biochar OR TITLE_ABS:lignocellulosic) AND OPEN_ACCESS:Y AND IN_PMC:Y AND HAS_PDF:Y AND FIRST_PDATE:[2025-01-01 TO 2026-11-06]
novel_metadata.selection: Newest exact-DOI and title-unique metadata with explicit biomass-derived porous or activated carbon in the title. Exclude prior matches, battery or review titles, title outcomes, explicitly composite or device-only titles. Verify against current source catalogs before reservation.
novel_metadata.result_boundary: Only bibliographic identity. No full text or terminal results for new metadata reservations.
